item.title: Researchers Improve Superconducting Qubit Coherence Using Tantalum and Silicon
item.summary: Insider Brief Quantum computing emerged with a promise of mythic proportions: machines capable of solving, in seconds, problems that would take today’s supercomputers millennia to compute. The power of quantum computing relies on quantum bits, or qubits – particles that can exist in multiple states simultaneously. Unfortunately, qubits are also notoriously fragile.
